cases.summary: Keep useful candidate results and their labels through failed replacements
cases.cause: Address input, retained result state and later program-download recovery cross browser and shared-flow boundaries. This case examines retained display state; it does not claim every repair in the referenced change shares that cause.

occurrences.evidence: The address/recovery change describes browser-filled input and working-result loss. Current requirements retain the original address, election and results through replacement failure. https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/pull/2474

prevention.description: The manual isolated Chromium/WebKit run exercises retained original results and labels, failed replacement, retry and newest-election cancellation. Existing flow tests cover responses that ignore cancellation. Physical phone autofill and live backend availability remain separate checks.

checks.anchor: failed replacement keeps the original results and labels through retry
newest election stays visible when an older cancelled request finishes last
keeps each displayed election and address together while changing selection and ignores a late older response

cases.summary: Keep address editing open and accept the first click or tap
cases.cause: Matching the previous request closed editing before explicit submission; suggestion dismissal moved the phone button between pointer press and release. These are distinct demonstrated mechanisms in 1 repair, not 2 inferred incidents.

occurrences.evidence: The repair and browser evidence establish the exact-address editing and button-movement failures. https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/pull/2477
Approved in-button waiting feedback follows the repair; it is not counted as another failure. https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/pull/2479

prevention.description: Existing editing and first-activation browser assertions run in the isolated local command. Native saved-address keyboard behavior remains untested by these simulated browser inputs.

checks.anchor: keeps address editing open when typing the previous request and closes only after submitting
visible suggestions allow the first Search button

cases.summary: Carry a reviewed disagreement only while both amounts remain unchanged
cases.cause: The comparison needs to remember the exact scope of a prior human ruling. Forgetting that ruling repeats the same block; remembering only the committee-year can allow a changed disagreement without review.

occurrences.evidence: The daily comparison repeatedly blocked already-reviewed unchanged disagreements. The repair retained their committee-years. https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/pull/2358

The follow-up restricted carry-forward to the exact payment sum and official amount, including missing historic figures. It addresses the opposite failure of overly broad approval, not another instance of the unchanged-data block. https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/pull/2368

prevention.description: The loader tests cover changed official totals and newly changed payment sums in both cent directions, preserve the prior live release, and require changed disagreements to block. A mutation comparing only the official amount passes the old case but fails both new cases. This status covers that scoped invariant, not every loader failure.
